title: Natural looking agave plant
text: Natural looking agave plant. It's just like it looks in the pics... it's plastic.. but agave plants sorta look stiff and plastic.. fooled a wild rabbit in my yard... He looked confused after he tasted it... :)  It will last for as long as I want it to I'm sure.  (Yes, I put it outside - inside a bigger pot)

product_metadata.title: Nearly Natural 30in. Agave Artificial Plant with Black Planter, Green
features: Bring nature inside with this beautiful, lush Agave. Standing 30" high, with an array of bold, spiny leaves pointing every which way, this plant looks like you've babied it for years (the fact that it never needs water will be our secret). Comes complete with a beautiful black planter, which makes it an ideal accent piece for both home or office. Makes a fine gift as well.

Shop with confidence knowing our collections.. "looks so real, they're Nearly Natural!" Pioneers in our industry; Nearly Natural is the first artificial floral company to hire head designers with years of experience in the live plant industry. We source products with a sound and in-depth knowledge of our industry..Nature.

Overall Product Dimensions: 17 In. W x 17 In. D x 30 In. H; Planter/Vase Dimensions: H: 9.5 In. W: 6 In. D: 6 In. Measurements are from the bottom of the planter/vase to the furthest extended flower or leaf on the arrangement. Width dimensions are also calculated from each furthest outstretched dimension.
No Maintenance Required; No Watering. Looks full and fresh every day; wipe clean with a soft dry cloth.
Ideal for both home and office use, this plant is 30" High & 17" Wide, mimicing the real plant with its 58 full leaves, but will never need water or sun. A natural looking base is included.
